name: KITKAT
ingredients_raw: Milk Chocolate (50.3%) (Sugar, Milk solids (12.1%), Cocoa butter (8.8%), Cocoa solids (6%), Emulsifier (Soya lecithin) & Artificial (Vanilla) flavouring substances), White chocolate (26.7%) (Sugar, Cocoa butter (8%), Milk solids (7.2%), Emulsifier (Soya lecithin) & Artificial (Vanilla) flavouring substances), Wafer (Refined wheat flour (Maida), Sugar, Hydrogenated vegetable fats, Cocoa solids (1.2%), Milk solids, Fractionated vegetable fat, Yeast, Raising agent (500(ii)), Emulsifier (Soya lecithin), lodized salt, Flour treatment agent (516), Artificial (Vanilla) flavouring substances & Nature identical flavouring substances). Allergen Note: Contains Wheat, Milk, Sesame & Soy. May contain Nut.
